content: The following UO2 properties were measured at room temperature: lattice constant 5.4704 angstrom, bulk modulus 207.5 GPa, density 10.97 g/cm^3, and melting point 3120 K. The thermal conductivity is 8.0 W/(m K) at 300 K, decreasing to 3.0 W/(m K) at 1500 K. Youngs modulus is 220 GPa and the shear modulus is 85 GPa. These values are consistent with the fluorite structure of uranium dioxide.
